position_overview: will support continued development and growth for a diverse slate of streaming events, ecommerce launches, editorial media and music related campaigns. This role involves executing digital campaigns, managing content calendars, and facilitating collaboration between marketing operations, editorial, and e-commerce teams. You will handle all aspects of social media from trend spotting to project management, publishing, and audience engagement, reposting opportunities and tagging, supported by regular reporting on campaign performance.
qualifications: possesses a keen awareness of emerging music and shopping trends, and excels at engaging with our audience. A proactive self-starter, you thrive in fast-paced environments and are skilled in problem-solving. Collaboration with the in-house Marketing team and the Creative and Growth teams will be essential in driving brand engagement and growth. Please include a portfolio showcasing your work, including examples of social media strategies you've implemented. WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO Content Publishing & Coordination: Manage the day-to-day operations of all brand social media channels (Instagram, X, Threads, Broadcast Channels, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Community, Veeps).
